artworks.title: Ismene and Antigone Plead with Theseus
artworks.description: SMK Copenhagen: Oedipus' daughters petition Athens' king — Theseus as public monarch of Attica, the hospitable ruler of Colonus and the Panathenaea.

artworks.title: The Embassy Hippolyta Sends to Theseus, King of Athens
artworks.description: Musée Jacquemart-André tradition (Carpaccio): Amazon envoys before Theseus as king of Athens — the synoecist monarch receiving foreign power in civic dignity.

popCulture.title: Oedipus at Colonus
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' last play makes Theseus the hospitable king — sheltering Oedipus at Colonus while Creon and Polynices press their claims.

popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: The synoecist of Attica — Panathenaea, Thebes' burial rites, and the public king whose virtue will break in his own house.

popCulture.title: Parallel Lives
popCulture.creator: Plutarch
popCulture.description: Plutarch's Life of Theseus gathers the kingship traditions — union of demes, Cretan tribute ended, and the hero as Athens' founding monarch.
